## Description

A globular oligotrich (20–40 µm, ~30 µm wide), one of the most common planktonic ciliates; it eats
bacteria, algae and small flagellates. It moves in jumps with rows of jumping bristles; between jumps
it barely moves: it rotates and filters with its membranelles.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 8 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Jumps](../../mechanics/behavioural-responses.md#jumps) of a few body lengths in tens of ms, spontaneous and as an
escape when the water deformation of an approaching predator exceeds ~2/s
([mechanoreception, M2](../../mechanics/behavioural-responses.md#m2--hydrodynamic-mechanoreception)). Speed,
duration, interval and threshold are orders of magnitude.

## Not implemented yet

## Unique and shared mechanics

The reference being for escape jumps; shares jumps with *Mesodinium* and shear responses with
*Vorticella*, *Stentor* and *Lingulodinium*.
